subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should this stale local Anthropic Vertex client branch be refreshed on current main, replaced by the current SDK 0.19 provider dependency path, or closed only after a maintainer-owned fix ships?
rationale: The PR changes an auth-provider dependency/request path, is conflicting and protected, and current main already moved the dependency chain, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent provider shape.

options.title: Refresh On Current Main
options.body: Rebase or rebuild the fix against current main, preserve the cache-control tests, and make the provider package/shrinkwrap match the chosen auth path before merge.

options.title: Accept Local Client Deliberately
options.body: Keep the BaseAnthropic/GoogleAuth replacement only with explicit maintainer acceptance plus live Vertex ADC proof and complete provider dependency metadata.

options.title: Close After Replacement Ships
options.body: If the current SDK 0.19 path is the intended fix, close this PR only after the replacement is shipped or the canonical issue is otherwise resolved.

recommendation.title: Refresh On Current Main
recommendation.body: Rebase or rebuild the fix against current main, preserve the cache-control tests, and make the provider package/shrinkwrap match the chosen auth path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and PR discussion make Vincent Koc the best available routing candidate for the dependency/auth-provider choice.
